source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, Schwab had full-time, part-time, and temporary employees, and persons employed on a contract basis, that represented the equivalent of approximately 33,000 full-time employees.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, consolidated statements of income (in millions)
source.quote: Expenses Excluding Interest Compensation and benefits 6,491 6,043 6,315 [in millions, 2025, 2024, 2023]

notes: Employees: a full-time-equivalent count that includes contractors (the 10-K's glossary defines FTEs as total hours worked divided by a 40-hour week), not a head count. Payroll: the income statement's 'Compensation and benefits' line. The 2026 proxy also reports a 2025 median employee annual total compensation of $131,480 (CEO pay ratio 143 to 1), not used because a total is disclosed.
